Positive branch of any first online query has Ldim≤2 because every subsequent positive center restriction is line / 2-point / empty, giving Ldim≤3. Copies of H(3,2) or H(2,4) shatter three fixed queries, and explicit complete ternary rook depth-three tree witnesses gap; d=1 and (2,2) direct.
